newsitem.title: UK: Petrofina drills 1st N.Sea Wendy field well-report.
newsitem.headline: Petrofina drills 1st N.Sea Wendy field well-report.

text.p: Petrofina SA has drilled the first well on the Middle Jurassic Wendy field in the northern North Sea since the field was discovered in 1977, consultants Arthur Andersen said in a weekly report.
The field was discovered by Phillips Petroleum Co when it drilled in block 210/15-2 located on the northwesterly margin of the East Shetland Basin. Petrofina took over operatorship in 1994.

Andersen said the original discovery well flowed 4,760 barrels of 38 degree API oil from the Brent Group. It said the block is being drilled as an appraisal/development well which will be used as a future producer if successful.
It added that a test was planned for the well, which is expected to take approximately 40 days to drill. Project approval is anticipated for the end of 1997 with first oil in 1999.
This would make it Petrofina's first operated development in the North Sea.
